title: Ninth Word Fourth Point Conclusion On Obligatory Prayer And Its Times

questions.question: What does the “second morning” make a person remember?
questions.answer: It makes a person think about the morning when people will be raised again.

questions.question: How sure does the passage say that rising after death is?
questions.answer: It says it is as sure and certain as the coming of morning after night.

questions.question: What other event is compared to that certain morning?
questions.answer: The season of spring after the Intermediate Realm is also described as certain.

questions.question: What do the five prayer times each begin?
questions.answer: Each one begins an important change or turning point.

questions.question: Besides daily changes, what larger time periods do these prayer times remind people of?
questions.answer: They remind people of changes in each year, each age, and each long period of history.

questions.question: What two things do these times call to mind about Allah?
questions.answer: They call to mind His power and His mercy.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of act are the required prayers?
questions.answer: They are a natural duty, the foundation of worship, and a debt that must be paid.

questions.question: Why are the required prayers described as especially suitable for these times?
questions.answer: Because these times remind people of great changes and of Allah’s mighty works and mercy.

questions.question: What future morning is linked with the morning that comes after night?
questions.answer: It is linked with the morning of resurrection.

questions.question: How does the passage use everyday morning to help people understand resurrection?
questions.answer: It uses the certain return of morning as an example to show that resurrection is also certain.

questions.question: What does the passage say about spring after the Intermediate Realm?
questions.answer: It says that it will surely come, just like morning surely comes.

questions.question: What is shared by all five prayer times?
questions.answer: All of them mark the start of an important change.

questions.question: What do these times remind people about every year, every age, and every epoch?
questions.answer: They remind people of Allah’s acts of power and His merciful gifts in all those periods.

questions.question: Which divine qualities are highlighted in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s power and mercy are highlighted.

questions.question: How are the prescribed prayers described in relation to worship?
questions.answer: They are described as the base or main support of worship.

questions.question: What final idea does the passage teach about praying at these times?
questions.answer: It teaches that praying then is very proper and well-matched to those times.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the “second morning” point to?
questions.answer: It points to the resurrection.

questions.question: What comparison is made between tomorrow morning and the resurrection?
questions.answer: The passage says both are equally certain.

questions.question: Which season is mentioned along with the resurrection morning?
questions.answer: Spring is mentioned.

questions.question: What comes before that spring in the passage?
questions.answer: The Intermediate Realm comes before it.

questions.question: What do the five prayer times each signal?
questions.answer: They each signal the beginning of a major change.

questions.question: What kinds of things do these times help people remember through Allah’s actions?
questions.answer: They help people remember His amazing power and His merciful blessings.

questions.question: Over what lengths of time are people told to notice these signs?
questions.answer: Over the year, over ages, and over long world periods.

questions.question: What three descriptions are given for the prescribed prayers near the end?
questions.answer: They are called a built-in duty, the basis of worship, and a debt that cannot be denied.

questions.question: What conclusion follows from all these reminders?
questions.answer: The conclusion is that the required prayers fit these times perfectly.

questions.question: What event after death is brought to mind by the morning mentioned here?
questions.answer: It brings to mind the resurrection.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the certainty of morning after night?
questions.answer: To help show how certain resurrection is.

questions.question: What other new beginning is mentioned besides resurrection morning?
questions.answer: A spring that comes after the Intermediate Realm.

questions.question: What do the five daily times have in common according to the passage?
questions.answer: They all begin important turning points.

questions.question: What do these daily times make people remember from larger history and time?
questions.answer: They make people remember great changes in years, ages, and long eras.

questions.question: Through whose power do these reminders happen?
questions.answer: They happen through the power of Allah.

questions.question: What kinds of blessings are connected to these reminders?
questions.answer: They are connected to gifts of divine mercy.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the duty of the required prayers?
questions.answer: It describes them as a natural responsibility and a debt owed to Allah.

questions.question: Why is it wise to pray at these exact times?
questions.answer: Because the times themselves match the meanings of worship and remind people of Allah’s greatness and kindness.

questions.question: What does the passage say the next morning resembles on a much greater scale?
questions.answer: It resembles the morning of resurrection.

questions.question: What everyday pattern is used as proof that resurrection is not impossible?
questions.answer: The steady coming of morning after night.

questions.question: What season is joined with the idea of life after the Intermediate Realm?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What is true of each of the five prayer times?
questions.answer: Each one starts an important change.

questions.question: What do these times remind people about in every year and every long stretch of history?
questions.answer: They remind people about Allah’s miracles of power and His gifts of mercy.

questions.question: What role do the prescribed prayers have in a Muslim’s worship?
questions.answer: They are central and foundational.

questions.question: What does it mean that the prayers are called an “incontestable debt”?
questions.answer: It means they are an obligation that cannot be honestly denied or pushed aside.

questions.question: What main message about prayer times does the passage leave with the reader?
questions.answer: It teaches that the required prayers belong at those times in a very fitting way.

questions.question: The passage says the “second morning” reminds people of what great event?
questions.answer: It reminds people of the resurrection.

questions.question: How certain is that event said to be?
questions.answer: It is said to be just as certain as the coming of morning after a night.

questions.question: What renewal after the Intermediate Realm is mentioned?
questions.answer: A spring-like renewal is mentioned.

questions.question: What does each of the five times mark the start of?
questions.answer: The start of a major transformation.

questions.question: What do these times help people remember besides daily change?
questions.answer: They help people remember major changes across years, ages, and epochs.

questions.question: What signs of Allah do these times bring to mind?
questions.answer: They bring to mind His mighty power and His merciful gifts.

questions.question: How are the required prayers connected to human nature in this passage?
questions.answer: They are presented as a duty placed in human nature.

questions.question: What two worship ideas are joined with the prescribed prayers near the end?
questions.answer: They are called the foundation of worship and a debt that must be fulfilled.

questions.question: What is the best summary of the ending of the passage?
questions.answer: Since these times carry such deep reminders, the prescribed prayers are exactly right for them.
